purpose: Non-admission discovery registry for NASA OPERA Sentinel-1 SAR observed surface-water extent and bounded flood-event validation research.

entries.name: NASA OPERA Dynamic Surface Water Extent from Sentinel-1 (DSWx-S1) Version 1
entries.spatial_scope: Near-global land observations from 84 degrees north to 84 degrees south, conditional on Sentinel-1 acquisition coverage and product validity.
entries.temporal_scope: PO.DAAC collection start 2023-12-01 to present; forward operational production began September 2024. Individual sensing time and collection release must be preserved.
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 30 m MGRS-tiled cloud-optimized GeoTIFF Level-3 surface-water classification with associated confidence products; mapped open water detection is limited for small or narrow water bodies.
entries.note: Frozen product name OPERA_L3_DSWX-S1_V1, DOI 10.5067/OPDSWS1-L3V1, NASA CMR collection C2949811996-POCLOUD. Registry of Open Data on AWS states CC BY 4.0, but exact granule permissions, Copernicus Sentinel input attribution, Earthdata credential requirements and commercial redistribution rights need source-specific review. SAR observed surface water is not necessarily an event-specific flood, water depth, recurrence probability or loss. Document baseline-water filtering, acquisition time, confidence flags, pixel geolocation, omissions, processing version and independence from CEMS GFM before any validation use.
